qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: PGM catalyst chemistry and refining know-how face cyclical automotive exposure and lack pricing power against major OEMs. Multi-year ROCE and ROIC languish at 6-8%, falling far short of the 12% threshold.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC < 12%, REJECT). Multi-year ROCE and GAAP ROIC of 6-8% fall well short of the 12% hurdle. The core Clean Air autocatalyst business faces structural terminal headwinds from vehicle electrification, compounded by past value-destructive capital allocation missteps in battery materials.
qualitative.evidence: 5-year average ROCE and GAAP ROIC languish at 6-8%, failing the 12% threshold. Core operating profit remains heavily reliant on ICE emission catalysts undergoing secular decline, while historical abortive attempts to pivot into battery materials resulted in £300M+ in asset write-downs.
